Vintage Writing Instrument Estate Lot
Cross 12KT Gold Filled Set and Garland Chrome Set

Accompanied by a two-piece Garland set, these writing tools represent mid-to-late 20th-century professional style. The Cross set is a classic Model 6601, known for its slim profile and durable gold-filled finish, making it a staple of executive stationery.

Garland Pen Set

Very good vintage condition. The Cross pieces appear well-preserved; one instrument remains wrapped in original protective tissue. The Garland pens show clean barrels and bright chrome finishes with minimal surface wear. Presentation boxes are intact with minor shelf wear on exterior edges. Ink cartridges have not been tested for flow or remaining capacity.
